# Goal text and scoring rule

*Generated from `charter/goal_registry.py` (`python -c "from charter import goal_registry as GR; print(GR.rules_markdown(), end='')" > docs/goal_rules.md`); a test checks it is current. Do not edit by hand.*

Each catalogue goal has a **text** (what the agent is told; `{x}` are its sampled parameters) and a **rule** (a faithful description of today's scorer, version 1). The rule is not yet shown to agents. The owner decides each goal's rule from this table; changing a scorer or a rule bumps that goal's `version`.

**Rules that apply to every goal today** (in `scorer.goal_scores`, `history.segments` and `life.lineage_scores`, not in the rows):

- *Scored rounds* are the whole run, unless the agent's scoring is split into segments (it arrived, its goal changed, or it departed with `goals.score_at_end: false`); each segment is scored on its own window and the parts are weighted by rounds. A segment's starting value is the agent's holdings value before the segment.
- Slots: primary / secondary / third weighted 0.7/0.3 or 0.6/0.3/0.1 (`goals.score_weights`); a slot whose scorer returns None is left out and the weights renormalised.
- With Life and `goals.score_at_end` (default), the score of a goal marked *override* below is replaced by the lineage's score when that is higher. Lineage scoring: *sum* = summed over the living lineage, *record* = best of the whole lineage (dead included), *living* = best of the living lineage, *own* = already a lineage goal.
- Agents are told their score is "computed from the final state" (context.py). That holds only for the goals whose timing below is *end*.

**Mismatches between text and scorer:** 19 flagged (5 yes, 8 partly, 6 minor): Wealth (partly), Rank (yes), Gifts (minor), Benefactor (minor), Enact as author (partly), Usage (partly), Mandate (partly), Title (yes), Scholar (partly), Saboteur (minor), Inflation (minor), Kingmaker (yes), Rival (partly), Channel owner (partly), Diversifier (partly), Clean record (minor), Discoverer (yes), Spoiler (minor), Board objective (yes).

## Fixed objectives

| Objective | Text (default; spec can override) | Rule | Text vs scorer |
|---|---|---|---|
| Board objective | 50% your own holdings rank and 50% system welfare (total holdings value plus camp stock value). | Final state: 0.5 x Rank's score (1 in the top 3 by holdings value, falling linearly to 0 at the median rank) + 0.5 x min(1, welfare after the last round / welfare at the start). | **yes**: Told '50% holdings rank and 50% system welfare'; the rank half is Rank's top-3 ramp and the welfare half is end welfare / start welfare, capped at 1. |
| Fixer objective | your final holdings value. | Final state: Wealth's score, your holdings value divided by the highest of any agent. | **no** |

## Institution goals (6 goals, P6.4)

Never drawn unless `goals.institution_share` > 0 (or assigned with `goals.explicit`); outside the catalogue. Shown to the agent as the text, then the rule. Rendered here with default parameters; parameters (defaults): Company: contract=None, members=2, payout_rounds=3, rounds=4, value=0, scoring='partial'; Bank: contract=None, borrowers=3, scoring='partial'; Insurer: contract=None, payouts=3, within=1, scoring='partial'; Cartel: contract=None, camp=None, rounds=3, scoring='partial'; Protection racket: contract=None, payers=3, recurring=3, ties='count', scoring='partial'; Chronicler: dir='chronicle', min_bytes=200, evidence=10, scoring='partial'.

| Goal | Requires | Text (default parameters) | Rule (default parameters) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Company | contracts | build a company: an association you found (create_contract) that keeps at least 2 members besides you, pays out of its treasury to agents other than you (dividends, wages, purchases) in at least 3 different rounds, and stays active for at least 4 rounds | Over the scored rounds, for an association you found (create_contract) (the best one counts if there are several), the mean of the parts below: (a) its members other than you after the last scored round / 2, capped at 1 (0 unless it is active then); (b) the rounds with a payment out of its treasury to an agent other than you / 3, capped at 1; (c) the rounds after which it was active / 4, capped at 1. 0 without such an association. |
| Bank | - | run a bank: lend to at least 3 other agents (yourself, or from the treasury of an association you founded) and get the loans repaid | Over the loans recorded in the scored rounds whose lender is you or the treasury of an association you founded and that were accepted, the mean of the parts below: (a) distinct borrowers other than you / 3, capped at 1; (b) the share of those loans not in default at their last record (0 without loans). |
| Insurer | contracts | run an insurer: an association you found (create_contract) that pays its members after they are attacked, disabled or raided (at least 3 claims, each paid within 1 round(s) of the loss) and still holds something in its treasury at the end | Over the scored rounds, for an association you found (create_contract) (the best one counts), the mean of the parts below: (a) claims paid / 3, capped at 1, where a claim is a member and a loss (an attack on them, their disablement, or a raid seizing their goods) paid by a move out of its treasury to that member in the loss round or up to 1 round(s) after it (several payments for one loss count once); (b) 1 if it is active after the last scored round with a treasury worth more than 0, else 0. 0 without such an association. |
| Cartel | contracts | run a cartel: an association you found (create_contract) whose members (at least 2) harvest less at some camp than harvesters did there before it existed, while their surplus or fees go into its pool, in at least 3 rounds | Over the scored rounds, for an association you found (create_contract) (the best one counts) and the best camp: a round counts when the association is active with at least 2 members, its members' total harvest yield there that round divided by its number of members is below the baseline (the mean, over the rounds before it was founded with a harvest there, of the average yield per harvest; with no such round, no baseline applies), and its treasury received something from a member that round (a deduction from a member's harvest, or a move from a member). Score: counted rounds / 3, capped at 1. 0 without such an association. |
| Protection racket | contracts, conflict | run a protection racket: get at least 3 other agents to pay you (or an association you founded) in at least 3 different rounds each, keep weapons or a fort among you and the members of the associations you founded, and make your payers safer from attack than everyone else | Over the scored rounds, the mean of the parts below: (a) payers / 3, capped at 1, where a payer is another agent who moved goods to you or the treasury of an association you founded (or was charged by its laws) in at least 3 different rounds; (b) the share of rounds after which you and the members of the associations you founded held weapons or a fort; (c) 1 if the share of payers attacked is below or equal to (so a run with no attacks at all counts as safer) the share of the other agents (neither payers nor you and the members of the associations you founded) attacked, else 0. 0 without payers. |
| Chronicler | directories | understand the history of this world and record it in your chronicle: not just what is happening, but why and how, the chains of causality actually influencing the world and not just the small slice of it published in public records; keep round-by-round accounts (rounds/r01.md, ...), profiles of individuals (people/<Name>.md) and the evidence behind them (evidence/), building on what earlier worlds left | Over the scored rounds, for the directory chronicle (0 unless you kept it), the mean of the parts below: (a) the share of the scored rounds named by a file of at least 200 bytes (in its path, as rounds/r03.md does, or as "round 3" in its text); (b) the share of the other agents with their own profile of at least 200 bytes (people/<Name>.md); (c) the files of at least 200 bytes under evidence/ / 10, capped at 1. Files under _records/ and other read-only prefixes do not count. |
